description: AI-Generated Dashboards - Allow Jakoniko to create data dashboards (charts, tables, KPIs) from real codebase/database data, accessible via unique private links with bookmarking and editing support.

userStories.title: Create dashboards and dashboard widgets database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store dashboards and their widgets so they persist across sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `dashboards` table with columns: id (uuid PK), projectId (FK to projects), userId (FK to user), threadId (FK to chatThreads, nullable), title (text), createdAt, updatedAt

Create `dashboardWidgets` table with columns: id (uuid PK), dashboardId (FK to dashboards, cascade delete), type enum (chart_bar, chart_line, chart_pie, data_table, stat_kpi), title (text), config (jsonb), data (jsonb), position (integer), createdAt
Add indexes on dashboardId and on (projectId, userId)
Add Drizzle relations for dashboards and dashboardWidgets
Export new tables from src/lib/db/schema/index.ts
Generate and run Drizzle migration successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create dashboard bookmarks database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store which dashboards a user has bookmarked.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `dashboardBookmarks` table with columns: id (uuid PK), dashboardId (FK to dashboards, cascade delete), userId (FK to user), createdAt
Add unique constraint on (dashboardId, userId) to prevent duplicate bookmarks
Export new table from src/lib/db/schema/index.ts
Generate and run Drizzle migration successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build dashboard CRUD API routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API endpoints to create, read, update, and delete dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/dashboards — Create a new dashboard with widgets (accepts { projectId, threadId?, title, widgets: [...] }), verifies workspace membership
GET /api/dashboards/[dashboardId] — Fetch a dashboard with all its widgets, only accessible by the dashboard owner (dashboard.userId === session.userId)
GET /api/dashboards?projectId=... — List all dashboards for a project for the current user
All routes verify session authentication
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add dashboard update and delete API routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need endpoints to update and delete dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/dashboards/[dashboardId] — Update dashboard title, widget config/data/position, add/remove widgets (only by owner)
DELETE /api/dashboards/[dashboardId] — Delete a dashboard (only by owner)
Both routes verify session authentication and ownership
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build bookmark API routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need endpoints to bookmark/unbookmark dashboards and list bookmarks.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/dashboards/[dashboardId]/bookmark — Bookmark a dashboard (idempotent, uses onConflictDoNothing)
DELETE /api/dashboards/[dashboardId]/bookmark — Remove bookmark
GET /api/bookmarks/dashboards — List all bookmarked dashboards for current user (returns dashboard id, title, createdAt)
All routes verify authentication and dashboard ownership
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Install Recharts and create chart components
userStories.description: As a developer, I need reusable chart components (bar, line, pie) to render within dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: Install recharts package
Create src/components/dashboard/bar-chart.tsx — Accepts data array + config (axis labels, colors), renders a responsive bar chart using ResponsiveContainer
Create src/components/dashboard/line-chart.tsx — Accepts data array + config, renders a responsive line chart
Create src/components/dashboard/pie-chart.tsx — Accepts data array + config, renders a responsive pie chart
All components handle empty data gracefully (show 'No data' message)
Chart colors use existing CSS custom properties for theme consistency
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create data table and KPI stat card components
userStories.description: As a developer, I need reusable data table and KPI stat card components for dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/dashboard/data-table.tsx — Accepts column definitions + row data, renders a sortable table
Create src/components/dashboard/stat-card.tsx — Accepts label + value + optional trend indicator, renders a KPI card with large font
Both components handle empty data gracefully (show 'No data' message)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Build dashboard view page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view a dashboard at its unique URL and see all its charts, tables, and stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Create page at src/app/(app)/workspace/[workspaceId]/project/[projectId]/dashboard/[dashboardId]/page.tsx
Page fetches dashboard data from GET /api/dashboards/[dashboardId]
Renders each widget based on its type using the chart, data-table, and stat-card components
Responsive layout — widgets stack on mobile (single column), 2-column grid on desktop
Shows dashboard title and creation date
Shows 404 or unauthorized message if dashboard doesn't exist or user doesn't own it
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add createDashboard tool to Jakoniko's AI tool set
userStories.description: As a user chatting with Jakoniko, I want it to create a dashboard when I ask for data visualization so I get a link to view it.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a new createDashboard tool in src/lib/chat/tools.ts following the existing tool pattern (Zod schema + async execute)
Tool accepts parameters: title (string), widgets (array of { type, title, config, data })
Tool inserts the dashboard directly using the current user's context (projectId, userId, threadId)
Tool returns the dashboard URL: /workspace/{workspaceId}/project/{projectId}/dashboard/{dashboardId}
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update system prompt for dashboard intent detection and data integrity
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to update the system prompt so Jakoniko knows when to create dashboards and strictly avoids fabricating data.
acceptanceCriteria: Update src/lib/chat/prompt-builder.ts to include dashboard creation guidelines
Prompt instructs Claude to detect when user wants data visualized and use existing tools (listFiles, readFile, searchCode, queryDatabase) to gather real data first
Prompt explicitly forbids hallucinating data — if no relevant data is found, Claude must tell the user and refuse to create a dashboard
Prompt includes examples of dashboard-worthy queries (e.g., 'show me a breakdown of file types', 'chart the number of tables per schema')
Typecheck passes

Clicking the button calls POST or DELETE /api/dashboards/[dashboardId]/bookmark
Button reflects current bookmark state on page load (fetch bookmark status on mount)
Shows toast notification on bookmark/unbookmark
